observations: Photo 0: Closed silver laptop with HP logo on lid, placed on wooden table with decorative flowers in background. Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI CIMLET INNOVATION' visible.

Photo 1: Laptop open, showing Windows desktop with time 13:04, date Thursday 23 October. Keyboard and trackpad visible. Sticker on palm rest reads 'HP ENVY x360 Laptop' with 'All-out performance' and QR code. Intel Core i5 sticker visible on bottom right of keyboard area. Watermark same as photo 0.
Photo 2: Side view of laptop in tent mode, showing hinge and back of keyboard. Ventilation grille visible on back. Watermark same as previous photos.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows sticker 'HP ENVY x360 Laptop' and photo 2 shows tent mode, confirming 2-in-1 convertible design. The '14' is not visible but consistent with typical x360 14-inch models.

Photo 1 shows an Intel Core i5 sticker, not i7. The sticker does not specify generation, but the model 'ENVY x360' with i5 is common in 11th gen, but the claim of i7 is not supported by visible evidence.
No internal components or system specs visible. Cannot verify SSD size or RAM amount from photos.
Screen size not directly visible or labeled. The model 'ENVY x360' typically comes in 14-inch variants, but not confirmed by photo.

response.reason: The model is identified as HP ENVY x360 from the sticker in photo 1, but key claims (i7, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) cannot be verified remotely. The i5 sticker contradicts the i7 claim. Without proof of internal specs and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately.
